About the Opportunity  

 An extremely busy bulk billing family practice established for 40+ years in the Denistone West area is urgently needing to replace a doctor who has suddenly retired. Currently turning patients away because their team is overwhelmed with too much demand, the incoming GP will have full patient books and a flexible roster to choose their preferred working hours. Based in a very central shopping location only a few minutes away from the nearest train station the practice is open all day weekdays and half day weekends with no compulsory weekend or evening shifts. Doctors have the potential to earn a generous proportion of the billings depending on their billing habits and number of patients they're comfortable seeing per hour. Despite being a very busy practice consultations are unhurried allowing doctors to be thorough without the pressure of having to rush through their appointments, they're happy to work with you as you see fit! With the assistance of a full-time nurse some of the services available here include children's health, minor surgery, chronic disease management, men and women's health issues, reproductive health, immunisations and general health assessments/check-ups for patients of all ages. An immediate start is available so whether you're available on a part-time or full-time basis please  APPLY  with your latest CV or contact us on the details below for more information.

A dynamic  mixed-billing  medical centre is offering a General Practitioner position in a highly desirable location. This is an excellent opportunity for a  Vocational Registered (VR) GP  to quickly build a substantial patient following, with Relocation Support available for the right candidate.

 GPs are afforded significant clinical autonomy and flexible working arrangements, allowing them to structure their practice using appointments, walk-ins, or telehealth consults based on personal preference. The centre supports professional development through access to accredited CPD webinars, training opportunities, and encourages involvement in research or education. Short-term agreements and no exclusivity requirements offer flexibility to suit diverse lifestyles. Located minutes from the coast, the position provides a fantastic lifestyle benefit, combining a highly supported professional environment with easy access to beaches and a vibrant community. Designated GP car parking is also provided.   Apply Now

result.description:
Only 12km from Brisbane CBD, this well-established mixed billing practice has grown from humble beginnings in 2013 to a experienced team of 7 GPs. Due to expansion and aquiring a nearby practice this client is looking for an additional  VR GP to join their friendly, supportive team.  This is an ideal opportunity for VR doctors impacted by the ten-year moratorium, with DPA available. 

 You’ll enjoy a large and loyal patient base, 2x full-time nurses, and the convenience of on-site allied health professionals,  including a physiotherapist, podiatrist, dietitian, psychologist, and audiologist. Plus pathology in-house and a pharmacy right next door. 

 They offer 70% of billings with a generous three-month guarantee, flexible work arrangements to suit your lifestyle, and intelligent practice tools like HotDoc and CUBIKO to make your day easier. DPA is available, and there’s plenty of underground parking. 

 If you’re looking for a welcoming team, a great location, and a practice where you can truly make a difference, let's hear from you. 

  What We Offer:  

 
	 
	  DPA Provision available.  
	 
	 
	  Fixed payment for the first three months.  
	 
	 
	 Flexible terms to support work-life balance. 
	 
	 
	 Pathology services conveniently located inside the practice. 
	 
	 
	 Pharmacy situated next door. 
	 
	 
	 Plenty of underground parking. 
	 
	 
	 Excellent transport links: peak hours every seven minutes, with a train line to the city. 
	 
	 
	 Family-friendly location: primary and secondary schools within 500 meters, and four childcare centres within 1km. 
	 
 

  What We Need:  

 
	 
	  AHPRA Registration as a General Practitioner.  
	 
	 
	 VR status (ideal for those restricted by the ten-year moratorium). 
	 
	 
	 Strong commitment to patient care and community engagement. 
	 
	 
	 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 
	 
	 
	  Dates:  Immediate start preferred (flexible terms available). 
	 
 

  To Apply:  

 Please submit your CV and a cover letter outlining your experience and availability.   Apply Now
